card.name: Dosage and administration heading words
card.fires_on: Responds to the word 'dosage' or the ending of 'ADMINISTRATION' and 'Dosage' in dosing section headings and cross-references. Also fires on 'cite' after 'How to' and on 'SYNOPSIS' in manual pages.

modes.label: Dosing headings
modes.description: The word dosage or the end of ADMINISTRATION or Dosage in dosing section titles and cross-references.
modes.example: See DOSAGE AND ADMIN<<ISTRATION>> for appropriate doses and dilutions.

modes.label: How to cite
modes.description: The word cite after 'How to' in web page citation prompts.
modes.example: How to<< cite>> this page Jewish Women's Archive

modes.label: Manual page headings
modes.description: The end of SYNOPSIS in a Linux manual page header.
modes.example: tmpfile - create a temporary file SYN<<OPSIS>> #include <stdio.h> FILE *

card.plain: It lights up on the dosage and administration section headings and the words that finish them, plus a few unrelated word endings like 'cite'.
